FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

ModelChoice.description: Which model to read: the current one, or the newest published.

oneOf.description:
The session's current revision's model, rebuilt if it isn't yet: what an agent that
just edited reads.

The newest model published, which may be an older revision's, read at once: what a
UI reads while a rebuild runs.

request.description:
`distance`'s request: the least distance between two elements, and their centres' and
normal distances where they have them.

elements.description:
The two elements, by name (as `elements` and `query` give them; an unstable name is
taken). The same name twice is 0 apart.

feature.description: The feature whose solid to find them in, or null for every body.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

request.title: DistanceRequest

Length.description: A length in millimetres: a number, to at most 6 decimals (nanometres). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

center_distance.description:
The least distance between the elements' centres (a vertex's point, a circle's or
arc's centre, a cylinder face's axis as an infinite line), if both have one.

center_to_element.description:
Where one element has a centre (a vertex's point, a circle's or arc's centre, a
cylinder face's axis) and the other is a planar face or a straight edge: a point
centre's least distance from the other as bounded, as FreeCAD's Quick Measure gives a
hole's centre to a face or an edge (so where the foot of its perpendicular falls off
the face, the distance to the nearest point of the face's boundary); a cylinder's
axis's distance from a plane or line it's parallel to, at exactly 0 degrees, and null
if it isn't. Null otherwise.

distance.description:
The least distance between the elements as bounded (never their infinite carriers),
in mm: 0 where they touch or cross.

from.description:
A point where it's met, on the first element: with `to`, one pair of points where
it's met (the pair first by its points' coordinates), a witness, not an identity.

normal_distance.description:
Where both are straight edges or planar faces at exactly 0 or 180 degrees: two faces
or two edges, the perpendicular distance from the second's reference point (a face's
centre of area, an edge's midpoint) to the first's plane or line; an edge and a face,
the edge's midpoint's from the face's plane, whichever comes first. Null otherwise.

to.description: The pair's point on the second element.
